svg.aria-label: Example 1: three modules expose a symbol to their parent, and the decisions above them produce three different reaches
svg.text: One decision, three reaches — where the chain above turns downward decides how far a symbol goes

g.text: D1 — shipping may not import InvoiceModel. invoicing exposed it to its descendants, and that
reaches its own subtree and nothing else; invoicing exposed it to no parent, so no sibling sees it.
goes no further; nothing gray moves
no marker: exposed to it by a proper ancestor
owned here / exposed to this module
grant flow: one decision, a subtree
arrowhead = this module may import it
optimizeRoute — exposed up, composed, stopped: parent only
The three owners made the same decision; the three reaches were decided entirely above them.
There is no sibling channel: exposing a symbol to the parent gives siblings nothing.
Files inside one module import each other freely; those imports are not drawn.
